behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert repeated entries with global/sticky expressions and unchanged caller lastIndex.
Assert literal string compatibility and a frozen RegExp.
docDelivery: Explain literal strings versus native RegExp including flags and sticky-at-zero semantics.
Explain fresh output, preserved order/duplicates and no caller state mutation.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Dense bounded string arrays; literal strings or genuine same-realm native RegExp, frozen supported, unsupported filters rejected.
independence: Accept RegExp filters without leaking lastIndex across entries or mutating caller-owned patterns.
